# Stock Portfolio Pro

> Production-grade portfolio tracker with hand-rolled D3 charts, real-time market data via Yahoo Finance, and Stripe subscription gating. Free no-signup demo, then a paid subscription (£27/month or £270/year).

Stock Portfolio Pro (stockportfolio.pro) is a web-based portfolio tracker and fundamentals analytics dashboard aimed at long-term retail investors who want clarity, not noise. Holdings are added manually, so no broker credentials are required. The product is owned and built by Avinash Sreekumar.

## Try it

- [Free demo (no signup)](https://stockportfolio.pro/demo): read-only dashboard with a sample 5-stock portfolio and live prices.
- [Free demo - fundamentals](https://stockportfolio.pro/demo/fundamentals): demo of the company fundamentals view.
- [Landing page](https://stockportfolio.pro/): full product overview and pricing.

## Sign up

- [Register](https://stockportfolio.pro/register): create an account and subscribe.
- [Log in](https://stockportfolio.pro/login)

## Pricing

- Free demo: no signup required, read-only.
- Monthly: GBP 27/month, billed monthly.
- Annual: GBP 270/year (saves GBP 54 vs monthly).

## Key features

- Holdings, allocation, and performance tracking with D3.js v7 charts.
- Company fundamentals view (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow).
- Real-time price data via Yahoo Finance (yahoo-finance2).
- JWT auth with Google and Facebook OAuth.
- Stripe subscription gating (monthly or annual).

## Tech stack

Node.js + Express, MongoDB Atlas, vanilla JS + D3.js v7, yahoo-finance2, Stripe, deployed on Render.
